Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

Present continuous: now

Iam wearingI am wearing my uniform.
Youare wearingYou are wearing black shoes.
He / Sheis wearingShe is wearing a blue skirt.
We / Theyare wearingWe are wearing our new uniform.
notam / is / are notHe is not wearing a tie today.

⭐ Use the present continuous for NOW: I am wearing… (hozir)

    Who is your brother or sister?

    💡 My brother/sister is … . He/She is … years old.

    What is your mom doing right now?

    💡 My mum is … right now.

Grammar Helper

My Mini Talk

Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

There is / There are

There isone thingThere is an egg in the fridge.
There aretwo or moreThere are six eggs.
Is there …?questionIs there a book on your desk?
Are there any …?questionAre there any eggs?
There are not anynegativeThere are not any cars outside.

⭐ Use any in questions and negatives: Are there any…? There are not any…

Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

How much? How many?

How many+ count nounsHow many oranges do you eat?
How much+ non-count nounsHow much water do you drink?

a bottle ofcontainerI buy a bottle of milk.
a kilo ofweightPlease buy a kilo of meat.

⭐ We can count oranges (one, two, three) but not rice or water. Use a box of / a bottle of.

❓ Do you ask permission before using things at home?

Yes, I always ask. I say, “Can I use the laptop, please?” My parents usually say yes.

Grammar Helper

🧩

Namunaga qarab o‘zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing.

-er than

short words+ -ertall → taller than me
words with -y-y → -ierfunny → funnier than you
long wordsmore + adjectiveinteresting → more interesting than
good / badirregulargood → better, bad → worse
thanafter the comparativeShe is smarter than me.

⭐ One or two short words: add -er. Long words: use more.
